findings.statement: The package-shape check reports API endpoint contracts as UNCHECKED. They are out of scope: the r10 interface inventory defines internal process coordination, C++ encoder status, media lifecycle, and a test fixture, and declares no public endpoints or cereal schema changes.

basis.ref: conditional API endpoint artifact is required only when endpoints are in scope

findings.statement: The package-shape check reports the frontend/UI handoff as UNCHECKED. This is a backend-only loggerd/encoderd change with no user-facing surface, and the manifest carries the typed no-surface applicability record.

basis.ref: conditional frontend/UI handoff applies only when a user-facing surface exists

findings.statement: The canonical package path resolves through skillset-saves to /data/media, outside /data/openpilot, so the shape validator refuses that path. The saved byte-identical in-project mirror passed with zero failures and the two expected conditional findings; the boundary validator independently checked the canonical r10 manifest and artifact hashes.

basis.ref: package-shape validator requires an in-project package directory

findings.statement: The deployed MPP version/build is not pinned, so safe post-EOS context continuation is unqualified. The r10 design correctly avoids treating the IDR command as proof of EOS-context reuse and retains the established planned close/open for healthy outputs; no in-place continuation guarantee should be inferred from this package.

Live RK3588 V4L2 DMA-BUF exporter behavior, fences/synchronization, live-camera MPP import, and buffer reuse remain unqualified. The carried M0 DMA-heap fixture evidence proves VisionIPC transport and fixture-owned lifetime only, not MPP import or full loggerd/encoderd rotation. The package keeps that limit explicit and makes no live-camera qualification claim.
